about: Georeference of districts.json: projected metres -> page space of the source PDF. Fitted by tools/georef_fit.py from control_points; check_points are held out of the fit. Used by sitegen/georef.py district_for().
page_space: PDF user space of the source page, y down

projection.name: NAD83 / Tennessee State Plane (EPSG:32136), metres
projection.datum_note: Inputs are NAD83 degrees; WGS84 (what a geocoder returns) differs by about 1 m here, far below the margin.

projection_finding: The PDF is drawn in Tennessee State Plane: the fitted affine has no measurable rotation or shear and equal x/y scale (see fit), and affine on projected metres fits to a few metres, while affine on raw lon/lat leaves 30-44 m residuals. Projective adds nothing (held-out max 4.9 m vs 4.5 m).
method: Control points are the sharp corners of the county line (turn over 30 degrees, both legs over 800 m) in the TIGER outline; the page_xy of each is the matching vertex of the PDF county outline, found near the spot predicted by a first outline-to-outline alignment. Check points are road crossings: the TIGER intersection, and on the page the crossing of the drawn centre lines whose course matches the TIGER lines (mean offset under 0.4 pt). Dual-carriageway I-24 uses the midpoint of the two carriageway crossings on both sides. Working scripts were one-off; tools/georef_fit.py refits from the points stored here.

tiger-county-2025.title: 2025 TIGER/Line Shapefile, Current County and Equivalent (U.S. Census Bureau), Montgomery County TN (GEOID 47125) and neighbours, as redistributed in USGS The National Map Governmental Unit Boundaries for Tennessee (GU_CountyOrEquivalent, load date 2025-09-23)
tiger-county-2025.licence: Public domain (U.S. federal government work; USGS metadata: no use constraints)

tiger-roads-tnm.title: USGS The National Map Transportation for Tennessee (Trans_RoadSegment), whose road lines come from Census TIGER/Line (2016 BAS All Roads; Lone Oak Rd and Rossview Rd segments from MAF/TIGER 2021 and 2018 extracts)

sources.access_note: The Census Bureau hosts (www2.census.gov, tigerweb.geo.census.gov, geocoding.geo.census.gov) were not reachable from the build sandbox on 2026-11-08, so the same TIGER data was read from the USGS redistribution. Nothing from APSU or mcgtn GIS services was used.

boundary_margin_basis.transform_note: largest leave-one-out control error (6.9 m); held-out check points max 4.5 m
boundary_margin_basis.traced_shapes_note: districts.json paths are simplified (0.8 pt tolerance) and rounded to 0.1 pt; measured max Hausdorff distance to the unsimplified trace is 0.98 pt = 28 m
boundary_margin_basis.geocoder_note: allowance for the Census geocoder, which interpolates along street address ranges and places the point on the street centre line; many district lines follow street centre lines, so an address on a boundary street can land on either side. Judgment call, not measured (the geocoder was not reachable from the sandbox).
boundary_margin_basis.outline_check: TIGER county outline sampled every 50 m against the PDF outline after the fit: median 1.5 m, p99 4.7 m, max 45.7 m.
